items.prompt: Repaint Image1 into the approved hand-painted anime card language. Image1 is the SELECTED COMPOSITION: KEEP the complete male figure from hat to boots, his upward bent arm and lifted palm, other hand gathering cloak near hip, tilted head looking toward his raised hand, feet at lower center, cloak sweeping to viewer right, immense eruptive FIRE CURTAIN lifted behind him like a heavy hanging sheet, opening above and framing his silhouette. Preserve camera, proportions, action, large fire silhouette, quiet space either side and grounded feet. Image2 is EXCLUSIVE character identity: Chang Wuyu is an adult MAN, silver-gray low hair bun and two long sidelocks, restrained golden eyes behind thin round glasses, pointed ears, black bent-tip wide-brim hat with purple lining, black high-collared long robe with purple cloak lining, restrained gold trim, black gloves and boots, WHITE FEATHER and BLUE SAPPHIRE GOLD CLASP at his left chest. Keep his recognizable refined masculine face, not a girl's face or older rugged face. Do not copy Image2's standing hand-on-glasses pose or fireball. Image3 is painting style ONLY: borrow its matte opaque grouped masses, broad economical direction strokes, handmade hard light-shadow edges and selective detail; do not copy its woman, hair, costume, moon or rain. Large grouped hair locks and principal robe folds, readable anime eyes/face and hands, restrained color lines merged into shadows. Repaint fire as a few enormous connected gold/ivory/orange flowing brush masses with blunt handmade edges, not hundreds of tiny flame tongues. Dark smoke and side background are quiet color planes, with firelight creating simple warm reflected shapes on figure. No smooth glossy cloth, dense hair strands, tiny decorative creases, fragmented mosaic triangles, heavy oil impasto or texture filter. Single square card illustration, no text/frame/UI/watermark.
